LET'S GET RID OF HIP TIGHTNESS & DISCOMFORT AT WORK. ⠀
⠀
⌨️ Sitting at the computer or desk for hours can wreak havoc on the low back and hips, causing aches and pain. Let's tackle this issue with a modified way to do a popular stretch, called the figure 4. ⠀
⠀
With this stretch, it will hit the glute and piriformis muscles, release hip tension and improve mobility. Oh, and it's super easy.👍⠀
⠀
So give it a try, relieve those achy hips, and hopefully it'll be one less thing to deal with at work. 😁⠀
⠀
Tag a friend living the desk life and share the good word!⠀

Dr. Rowe, chiropractor in St. Joseph, MI, has advanced training in complex joint and soft tissue problems that may cause neck and back pain and draws from a variety of treatment techniques, including chiropractic and spinal decompression therapy.
